_comment: Two records from one allocation site: the first is provided as an unrelated Config service, the second (holding only a string) is a Schedule's input whose callback calls the method of a captured service that the string names. Only the first is a service, so the second may enter the Schedule: the named method stays, the unread one is removed and the bundle runs. Guards that the Schedule input filter does not drop an object because its allocation site may also be provided.
